tests.skip_reason: Existing external NSE/NIFTY fixture not supplied

professor_workbook.reason: Supplied XLSX has zero cached purchases/investment and blank returns/ranks; formulas are extracted and verified purchase arithmetic is implemented separately.

professor_style.reason: Fractional proxy for historical profit/loss, not executable whole-share workbook reproduction. Common-cohort mean IC -0.046888; top-20 goal achievement 0.28125.

xirr.reason: Cash-flow accounting verified, but almost identical ordering to profit/loss under a common fractional contribution schedule; no independent factor vote justified.

goal.reason: Best goal-oriented development result among principal candidates: top-20 achievement 0.591667 and shortfall 0.074377 versus baseline 0.5625 and 0.091606. Mean IC 0.013544 with descriptive date-block interval [-0.012588, 0.039676]; insufficient independent evidence.

personalized_existing.reason: Unvalidated equal rank blend did not improve goal outcomes over baseline; mean IC -0.043951 and top-20 shortfall 0.097109. Do not adopt the proposed weights.

family_aggregation.reason: Current quality/valuation integration and family ablations work; equivalent PIT historical inputs are absent, so predictive comparison is unavailable.

ridge_personalized.reason: Mean IC 0.048020 but top-20 achievement 0.3625 and shortfall 0.125716 are worse than goal ranking and baseline. Better IC alone does not establish investor suitability.

ridge_ablations.reason: Removing risk raised mean IC to 0.069813; removing goal raised it to 0.05158. Neither rescued top-20 goal utility. Added factors did not earn automatic inclusion.

lambdarank.reason: Mean IC 0.011208 and top-20 achievement 0.533333 provide no compelling improvement over transparent goal ranking.

cluster_rank_aggregation.reason: Train-only correlation clustering is implemented, but mean IC -0.040185 and shortfall 0.109109 do not justify selecting it. Transparency alone did not improve outcomes.

whole_share_full_universe.reason: Verified raw-price action-ledger simulator is tested for affordability, liquidity caps, fees, splits and dividend entitlements. Accepted provider-adjusted prices cannot certify actual historical whole-share purchases.

interpretation: All performance statistics are exploratory averages across four validation dates and six profiles on the common cohort. Overlapping outcomes, survivor selection and current sector labels prevent a generalization claim. No locked or prospective test was opened, no model promoted, and no calibrated probability of achieving 20% is claimed.

personalization.explanation: Amount scales fractional wealth without changing percentage quality. Intervals change purchase timing; lookback changes evidence; horizon changes scenario length; target changes capped goal shortfall. Whole-share constraints and fixed fees are distinct tested nonlinear amount effects.

recommended_next_milestone: Build and audit an official-source historical security-membership, identity, corporate-action and delisting ledger; repair stale execution endpoints and obtain a usable professor execution snapshot. Then preregister and prospectively freeze goal-shortfall versus professor-style, existing baseline and Ridge-ablation rankings across investor profiles. Require new matured outcomes and PIT quality/valuation coverage before choosing a final personalized model.
